create_gossiper_instance: create a Gossiper instance with a message tensor, graph manager, and optional mixing manager for multi-peer communication
run_pushsum_mix: run a single PushSum consensus averaging step by calling mix on a PushSum gossiper with an outgoing message tensor
run_pushpull_mix: run a single PushPull doubly-stochastic consensus averaging step by calling mix on a PushPull gossiper with an outgoing message tensor
run_bilatpushpull_mix: run a bilateral PushPull consensus averaging step by calling mix on a BilatPushPull gossiper with a single peer
refresh_gossiper_peers: refresh the in and out peers of a Gossiper instance by calling refresh_peers with an optional rotate flag
